solution.paragraph: Let $$u = \ln x$$ and $$dv = x^{2}dx$$ , so that $$du = \frac{1}{x}dx$$ and $$v = \frac{1}{3}x^{3}$$ . Therefore,

$$\begin{array}{l} {{\int{x^{2}\ln xdx}} = {\int{udv = uv - {\int{vdu}}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x^{2}\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{3}x^{3}\ln x - {\int{\frac{1}{3}x^{2}dx}}}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x^{2}\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{3}x^{3}\ln x - \frac{1}{9}x^{3} + C}} \\ {\phantom{\int{x^{2}\ln xdx}} = {\frac{1}{9}x^{3}\left( {3\ln x - 1} \right) + C}} \end{array}$$
